records.name: Vue UTable
records.purpose: Render tabular values with sorting, filtering, selection, paging, grouping, editing, expansion and optional virtual scrolling.
records.surface: Each is an Options API SFC extending its exported base factory, which extends createBaseComponent from @ultimate/vue-core; mounted registers its component style and cx resolves its local class map. Source-only style module is not re-exported by the family barrel. No plugin, directive or composable is exported by the family entry. UTable and createBaseTable; source-only tableStyleModule. Declared props: value, columns, dataKey, sortMode, sortField, sortOrder, multiSortMeta, filters, selectionMode, selection, compareSelectionBy, selectionColumn, paginator, lazy, loading, first, rows, totalRecords, rowsPerPageOptions, virtualScrollerOptions, editMode, editingRows, groupRowsBy, rowGroupMode and expandedRowKeys. Emits declared: sort, filter, update:selection, selection-change, page, lazy-load, update:editingRows, row-edit-save, row-edit-cancel, update:expandedRowKeys, row-expand and row-collapse. The declared filter event has no emit site. sortColumn emits sort with order 1; no update:sortField or update:sortOrder is emitted. Module-local resolveCell, renderCell, compareValues, matchesFilter, matchesFilterEntry and DEFAULT_EMPTY_MESSAGE are owned implementation details, not barrel exports. Column definitions are local JSDoc (field, header, body(row, {field, rowIndex})); UTableColumn is not an exported type. The body return is interpolated rather than mounted by a custom VNode renderer. No slots. effectiveValue applies local committed row overrides keyed by dataKey; sorting copies rows and supports single and multi-sort, with null-first, numeric or locale string comparison. Filters read field metadata, combine constraints with and/or, and implement contains, startsWith, notContains, endsWith, equals, notEquals, lt, lte, gt, gte, between, in, notIn, dateIs, dateIsNot, dateBefore and dateAfter; custom returns false and unknown modes true. Pagination slices the filtered value; grouping occurs on the paged rows with subheader or rowspan. The virtual branch passes filteredValue to UScroller and renders columns and selection interactions rather than the regular editing, expansion and grouping cells. UPaginator's page event is forwarded; consumers supply changed first/rows. Selection is controlled through update:selection and selection-change; equality uses uix-data equals with dataKey or uix-utils deepEquals; toggle-all uses effectiveValue. Keyboard supports arrows, Home/End, Space/Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+A for multiple selection, guarding selection keys on child controls; DOM sibling navigation can encounter grouping or expansion rows. editingRows seeds local state once; edits keep row-index drafts and save local committed overrides without update:value or a watcher to resync editingRows. Expansion is controlled through expandedRowKeys and renders an empty placeholder row. Loading and the internal 'No results found' empty message are rendered in the nonvirtual branch. tableStyleModule imports @ultimate/uix-styles/table and declares root/table/thead/tbody/row class resolvers; cx('rowGroupHeader') has no corresponding local class entry, and the row resolver receives no selected parameter at its call site.

records.name: Vue UPaginator
records.purpose: Render page navigation and report requested page changes.
records.surface: Each is an Options API SFC extending its exported base factory, which extends createBaseComponent from @ultimate/vue-core; mounted registers its component style and cx resolves its local class map. Source-only style module is not re-exported by the family barrel. No plugin, directive or composable is exported by the family entry. UPaginator and createBasePaginator; source-only paginatorStyleModule. Declared props first, rows and totalRecords default to 0, pageLinkSize defaults to 5. Emits page, update:first and update:rows. The component watches first and rows into d_first and d_rows. It computes a bounded page link window and a page count through @ultimate/uix-data getPageCount; page is floor(d_first/d_rows) for positive rows and 0 otherwise. changePage validates a requested first index, mutates d_first and emits page with {page, first, rows, pageCount}, then update:first and update:rows. The fixed nav renders first, previous, numbered, next and last buttons with aria labels, aria-current on the active page and a polite page report. No slots or page-size dropdown. paginatorStyleModule imports @ultimate/uix-styles/paginator and defines local classes including currentPageReport; Aura registers a paginator preset.

records.name: Vue UScroller
records.purpose: Render a vertical window over items with optional lazy-load notifications and a content slot.
records.surface: Each is an Options API SFC extending its exported base factory, which extends createBaseComponent from @ultimate/vue-core; mounted registers its component style and cx resolves its local class map. Source-only style module is not re-exported by the family barrel. No plugin, directive or composable is exported by the family entry. UScroller and createBaseScroller; source-only scrollerStyleModule. The base declares items (empty array), itemSize (0), numToleratedItems (null); the SFC adds disabled, loading and lazy (false) and emits lazy-load. It measures vertical viewport height on mount, observes resize with ResizeObserver and disconnects on unmount; itemSize and items changes recompute the window. calculateNumItemsInViewport and calculateLast come from @ultimate/uix-data; default overscan is ceil(viewport/2), with last clamped to live items length. visibleItems contains {index,value} for the window, or all items when disabled; disabled does not disable scroll processing. The content slot receives items, getItemOptions, itemSize and loading; default rows are interpolated and positioned absolutely at index*itemSize within a content element of items.length*itemSize height. onScroll computes first from scrollTop/(itemSize||1); when first changes, lazy mode emits {first,last} asynchronously via Promise, not on initial mount. Instance methods include scrollTo(options), scrollToIndex(index, behavior='auto'), getItemOptions(index) returning {index,count,first,last,even,odd}, getLast(last=0,isCols=false), recompute and onScroll. getLast uses the same item length for either isCols branch. scrollerStyleModule imports @ultimate/uix-styles/virtualscroller and defines local u-scroller CSS and class names.
